Privacy details

Privacy & browser storage

Read, explore and download without creating an account in this application.

Who is responsible

Lab of Codes & Kolmeia is the operator identified for this site. Privacy requests: info@kolmeia.io. Business units: Braga, Portugal and Florianópolis, Brazil.

What this application does

The application uses no analytics, advertising, tracking pixels, remote fonts, cookies or persistent browser storage. Checklists and canvas fields exist only in the open page and disappear on reload. Downloaded files remain on your device.

Hosting and external services

The public website is hosted on Hostinger. The hosting provider may process connection and security information under the applicable service terms. This application adds no analytics, tracking cookies or remote fonts. GitHub and reference publishers apply their own policies when you follow an external link. Contact the operator about provider processing and retention.

Your rights and the legal context

LGPD and GDPR/RGPD may apply according to the processing context, not the selected language. You may contact the operator about access, correction, deletion, objection and other applicable rights. This notice describes the application; actual hosting arrangements and lawful processing must be confirmed by the operator.
